08. Linux Commands

Shell commands inspect paths, files, processes, disk space and services; use least privilege and
verify paths before modifying files.
Linux commands වලින් folders, files, processes සහ system status බලනවා. rm Jහහෝ sudo
භාවිතයට කලින් path එක Jහාඳින් check කරන්න.
Investigate an application log on an authorized local machine.

pwd / ls: paths grep / tail: logs · ps / top: processes df / du: storage · Read the diagram: pwd / ls: paths / grep / tail: logs / ps / top: processes / df / du: storage. · Linux commands වලින් folders, files, processes සහ system status බලනවා. rm Jහහෝ sudo භාවිතයට කලින් · path එක Jහාඳින් check කරන්න.

ps aux
df -h
# On your own app: tail -n 20 app.log
Expected result: Commands show current path, directory entries, processes and disk usage.

Q: How do you inspect the last 20 log lines?
A: Use tail -n 20 with the log file path.
